title: Landfall
summary: Kindred's colony on Verdance. Land outside the wire, walk one drone to the gate without firing (attacking Kindred sets kindred-attacked, then kindred-hostile: the mission fails), meet Marrow at the council hall (cine-marrow), compare archives (three-histories, director-two). Honest or not at the hall decides kindred-ally later.

objectives.text: Walk a drone up to Kindred's gate. Don't fire on them
Meet Captain Marrow at the council hall

fails.text: Kindred closed their gate to us.
